seed: php artisan mock:sample-day travel --email=<account> && E2E_EMAIL=<account> php artisan db:seed --class="Database\Seeders\MockSample\PaperworkSeeder" && E2E_EMAIL=<account> php artisan db:seed --class="Database\Seeders\MockSample\TravelSeeder"

init: if (location.pathname === '/up') { (async () => { const xsrf = decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.match(/XSRF-TOKEN=([^;]+)/) || [])[1] || ''); const headers = { Accept: 'application/json', 'X-XSRF-TOKEN': xsrf, 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }; try { const day = await (await fetch('/api/day?date=2026-09-30', { headers, credentials: 'same-origin' })).json(); if (day.active_trip) await fetch('/api/trip/end', { method: 'POST', headers, credentials: 'same-origin' }); } finally { location.replace('/travel'); } })(); }

note: A lift out of order at Neumarkt (the mock's ?scenario=lift) on the trip card, with the way open: MockSample\SampleKvb under the local mock_scenario cookie; the card matches it to the way's stations by KVB station and distance (TripConditions::liftsOut, the same as Plan a trip). The app's line in the open way ("A lift at Neumarkt is out of order; KVB doesn't say if it's on your way.") has no counterpart in the mock's lift card. Each width starts with no trip running: the app side opens /up, ends any trip the account has through the app's own API, then opens Travel (as travel-plan-saved resets its planned way), so nothing a width leaves behind carries over.
